subject: Request: Staggered backup purge, log-exception & emergency restore escrow (NordicPilot)
messages:
From: Sara Larsen <sara.larsen@nordicpilot.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>
Cc: Contracts Team <contracts@nordicpilot.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Apr 2028 08:14:00 +0200
Subject: Request: backup purge schedule + temporary restore escrow window

Hi Michael,

Quick summary: as we ramp the NordicPilot integration into our EU pilot next month, our legal team is requesting clarity on Redwood's upcoming backup purge and deletion windows for tenant snapshots and logs. We need two things before go-live:

- A staggered purge timetable that prioritizes non-production snapshots first but guarantees a short emergency restore escrow for critical telemetry (we're asking for a 30-day hold on deleted snapshots for the pilot account only).
- A formal exception for log retention: we collect extended debug traces for ~7 days today; legal wants confirmation they can request a 90-day trace hold for forensic purposes during the pilot.

Attached is our suggested DPA amendment request (NordicPilot_DPA_change_request.pdf) that outlines the ask and regulatory justification.

Can you share the engineering plan (how purge will be phased, who the subprocessors are for backup storage, and what the restore cadence would look like)? Also whether an escrow snapshot can be isolated under customer-managed keys (we prefer KMS control).

We'd like to lock this before our procurement kickoff next week. If a narrow exception isn't possible, please propose an alternative SLO we can accept.

Thanks — Sara
Sara Larsen
Head of Ops, NordicPilot

--
Attachment: NordicPilot_DPA_change_request.pdf (application/pdf, 98KB)

From: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>
To: Sara Larsen <sara.larsen@nordicpilot.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Apr 2028 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: backup purge schedule + temporary restore escrow window

Hi Sara — thanks for the clear ask and the DPA draft. Appreciate the regulatory notes.

High-level proposal from Redwood infra & compliance:

1) Staggered purge timetable (pilot-only):
   - Week 0 (pilot kickoff): snapshot freeze for production tenant while we seed escrow snapshot(s).
   - Week 1: non-prod snapshots (dev/staging) purge phase 1 — immediate deletion after verified snapshot replication completion.
   - Week 3: production snapshot tier purge phase — deletions executed but held in a short-term escrow bucket for 14 days by default.
   - Emergency restore escrow: we can offer a 30-day escrow for the pilot as a contractual exception, but this requires an amendment to the DPA and explicit subprocessor commitments (see below).

2) Log retention exception: by default, platform logs are retained for 7 days; we can accept a formal 90-day forensic hold for specific log classes (debug/trace) only under a documented legal request flow and audit trail. We'll need:
   - a list of exact log streams you want held,
   - an RPM/alert for access requests, and
   - a clear retention cutoff trigger.

3) Subprocessors & key control:
   - Backup storage today uses two subprocessors (object-store partner + cold-archive partner). We can provide the current subprocessor matrix and an SLA addendum for the ones serving EU regions.
   - For customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM), we support envelope encryption and can place the escrow snapshots under a customer KMS key for the duration of the escrow hold. This requires a small ops runbook and an onboarding window (2–3 business days).

I've attached a proposed purge timetable (redwood_proposed_purge_timetable.xlsx) and flagged the fields we'd like NordicPilot to confirm (which snapshots, which log streams, and whether you require KMS control).

Next steps (proposal):
 - You confirm the exact log streams and acceptance of 30-day escrow for the pilot.
 - We'll generate a DPA amendment and subprocessor list; Markus will lead the compliance sign-off.
 - If accepted, we can schedule a 30-minute kickoff to run through the operational playbook and DocuSign the DPA amendment.

I'll leave Markus and Laura on-thread for the legal/ops checks.

Cheers,
Michael Grant
Head of Platform Partnerships, Redwood Inference

--
Attachment: redwood_proposed_purge_timetable.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet, 45KB)

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>, Sara Larsen <sara.larsen@nordicpilot.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 20 Apr 2028 09:22:00 +0200
Subject: Re: Request: backup purge schedule + temporary restore escrow window

Thanks — quick notes from legal & compliance:

- DPA amendment: we can accept a 30-day escrow for the pilot but need the amendment to explicitly enumerate the scope (which datasets/snapshots and who can request restores). Please see the attached subprocessor_matrix.csv — it lists current EU-region subprocessors and contact points.

- Log exception: 90 days is acceptable for forensics on a case-by-case basis, but we require:
  * A written legal request with case id,
  * RBAC audit trail for anyone accessing held logs, and
  * A retention termination plan (how logs will be deleted after the exception ends).

- Cross-border notes: because NordicPilot is EU-first and your data must remain in-region, the escrow snapshots must remain in our EU storage region. If you require cross-border movement for restores, we need a separate transfer agreement.

Action items for Michael/Laura:
 1) Michael: confirm ops playbook steps for creating a customer-held escrow snapshot with customer KMS.
 2) Laura: generate a one-page DPA amendment draft (I can review).
 3) Michael: update the proposed_purge_timetable.xlsx to show an EU-only storage column and the canary rollback window (we suggest a 21-day canary with automatic rollback at day 22 unless a restore is requested).

I'll also open a DocuSign envelope for the DPA amendment so Contracts can sign in parallel. Link below once live.

-Markus

--
Attachment: subprocessor_matrix.csv (text/csv, 12KB)

From: Sara Larsen <sara.larsen@nordicpilot.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Contracts Team <contracts@nordicpilot.com>
Date: Sat, 20 Apr 2028 18:02:00 +0200
Subject: Re: Request: backup purge schedule + temporary restore escrow window

Michael / Markus — this looks good and addresses our main concerns. A few quick confirmations before we sign:

1) We accept a 21-day canary rollback for EU-only escrow if Redwood will extend escalation privileges to our security contact (sara.larsen@nordicpilot.com) for restore requests during the pilot.
2) We'll ring-fence the log streams to the minimal set (auth/debug/ingest) and send that list by Monday 22 Apr.
3) Please share the DocuSign link when the DPA amendment is ready — we'll turnaround on our side within 48 hours of receipt.

If those three items are met, Contracts will proceed. Can we book a 30-min ops walkthrough next Tue 23 Apr 14:00 CET?

Thanks — Sara

--
(Agreement in principle; Contract to follow)
